title: Care without spending
odia:
ଅଣ୍ଟାରୁ ପଇସା ସାରିବି ନାଇଁ
ପୁଅକୁ ନୁଖୁରା ରଖିବି ନାଇଁ।
literal_meaning: I will not spend the money at my waist; I will not leave my son dry and unoiled.
meaning_odia: ପଇସା ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ମନ ନାହିଁ, ଅଥଚ ପୁଅର ଯତ୍ନରେ ଅଭାବ ରଖିବାକୁ ବି ମନ ନାହିଁ। ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ବିନା କାମ ସାରିବାର ଏହି ଦୁଇମୁହାଁ ଇଚ୍ଛାକୁ କଥାଟି ଧରିଛି।
explanation: The speaker wants to keep every coin while also seeing the son cared for. The image of leaving him dry and unoiled makes that tension concrete. The inspected Odia Vasa gloss reads the saying as the miser’s conflict between holding on to money and wanting a task accomplished.
usage_example: A person wants a broken household item repaired properly but refuses every necessary expense. Someone could use this saying to point out the conflict. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: ନୁଖୁରା carries the sense of dryness or absence of oiliness. Applied to the son, it is read here as being left unoiled, with care or upkeep as the wider implication. The verse does not specify hair, skin, a particular oil, or a grooming ceremony.

witnesses.locator: Inspected page lines 83–85 and repeated at line 102, beginning ଅଣ୍ଟାରୁ ପଇସା.
witnesses.note: Supplies complete first word ଅଣ୍ଟାରୁ where upload page 1 has a missing-box glyph. Upload page 2 begins with readable second line. Preserve uploaded ନାଇଁ and two-line form. Shared lineage is possible.

Wording uses ନାହିଁ in both clauses rather than displayed ନାଇଁ. Its parenthetical gloss describes a miser caught between retaining money and accomplishing a desired task. This supports interpretation without proving independent origin.

variants.odia:
ଏଣେ ପୁଅ ମୁଣ୍ଡକୁ ଆଶା
ତେଣେ ତେଲ ଘଡିକି ଆଶା।
variants.locator: Hello Odia line184; uploaded compilation page5.
variants.note: Related alternate expression selected editorially for the same son-care versus resource-retention image. Upload has ଘଡିକି; public witness has ଘଡ଼ିକି. No established textual descent. Literal reading: On this side, concern for the son’s head; on that side, concern for the oil pot. ଅର୍ଥ: ପୁଅର ମୁଣ୍ଡରେ ତେଲ ଲାଗୁ ବୋଲି ଇଚ୍ଛା, ଆଉ ତେଲ ଘଡିରୁ ତେଲ ନସରୁ ବୋଲି ବି ଇଚ୍ଛା। ଯତ୍ନ ଓ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ବଞ୍ଚାଇବାର ଏହି ଦୁଇ ଟାଣ ଏକାଠି ହୋଇଛି। Explanation: The same person values care for the son and preserving the oil supply. Oiling the head uses up oil: the two attachments pull in opposite directions. This is an editorial reading of the paired concrete objects, not an independently located gloss of this exact form. Locator: Hello Odia line184; uploaded compilation page5.

odia_summary: ପଇସା ବି ରହୁ, ପୁଅର ଯତ୍ନ ବି ହେଉ—ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚକୁ ନେଇ ଦୁଇମୁହାଁ ଇଚ୍ଛା।
english_summary: Wanting the care provided while refusing the expense it takes.
